summary: Phase 1 (Audit 08_SQL) complete. All 5 steps executed and verified. Final artifact: `/mnt/e/Dev_World/04_Practice/Daily-Prep/08_SQL_AUDIT.md` (~770 lines). Key outputs: (1) Header with Ferment ID + 2026-06-14 date + 51-file scope; (2) Dimension Definitions table (5 dimensions × sub-checks, 0-3 scale); (3) Threshold rule (avg<2.0 OR any dim=0); (4) **Scoring Matrix: 51 rows** with all teaching files scored on 5 Combined Lens dimensions (CD/TB/PR/HE/PC) + Avg + Flagged? + Priority columns; (5) **FLAGGED FILES section: 39 P[012]-UPGRADE entries** (P0=3 for avg<1.6: 17_Practice_100_Problems 0.8, 19_Interview_Top50 0.8, 20_CheatSheet_QuickRef 1.0; P1=18 for 1.6≤avg<2.0; P2=18 for avg≥2.0 with HE=0); (6) Each flagged entry has detailed evidence block with dimension-by-dimension quotes + priority rationale + estimated effort; (7) FOLDER-LEVEL OBSERVATIONS with 8 ASCII-art analyses (dimension heatmap CD=2.5/TB=2.6/PR=1.4/HE=0.2/PC=2.5, priority histogram, gap histogram, file cluster analysis, named predecessors timeline, production failure mode taxonomy with 15 modes catalogued, full file ASCII heatmap, comparison to 05_Problem_Solving); (8) CONTEXT UPDATE RECOMMENDATIONS including proposed D015 rule for SQL canonical HE timeline in DECISIONS.md; (9) VERIFICATION footer with cross-check totals (all 3 consistency checks PASS). Key finding: HE is universally absent (38 of 51 files score 0 on HE; folder-level advisory 1.0 was misleading — actual per-file avg is 0.2). Production Reality is bimodal (3-3-0 for scenario/interview/quickref clusters). CD/TB/PC are strong throughout (avg 2.5/2.6/2.5). Two git commits landed on main: initial audit doc + matrix row-fix + renumber + footer.
